# Roadmap (generated by `tools/milestone.py roadmap` — do not edit)

| R0 | NOT-STARTED | Host toolchain ready | - | scripts/doctor.sh reports every required tool with real versions and missing=0. Negative: run with an empty PATH, missing>0. |
| R1 | NOT-STARTED | Firmware imported and hash-locked | R0 | Importer copies the user's stock archive contents into firmware/extracted using real tools, prints real sha256 of archive and key images (boot, super, vbmeta, dtbo) and compares them to config/firmware.lock.json. Negative: tampered copy compares unequal. |
| R2 | NOT-STARTED | Stock kernel Image and DTB extracted with real tools | R1 | From the real boot.img: kernel Image and DTB(s) extracted with real tools into build/stock/. Evidence prints the stock kernel version string and the decompiled DTB compatible. Negative: same commands on an empty file yield neither. |
| R3 | NOT-STARTED | QEMU machine `cepheus` skeleton | R2 | Custom QEMU (pinned, overlay applied, built by scripts) starts machine `cepheus` paused (-S) with 8 CPUs and the SM8150 memory map taken from the stock DTB; monitor `info cpus` and `info mtree` show it. Negative: stock-style `-machine virt` run lacks the SM8150 regions. |
| R4 | NOT-STARTED | Stock kernel boots with native GENI UART | R3 | Stock Image + stock DTB boot on `cepheus`; kernel messages appear on the NATIVE GENI UART model via earlycon. Negative: UART model disabled -> no kernel output. |
